_comment: Default per-model WiiM device capability overrides. Edit the copy in the app data directory (next to settings.json) to change behaviour without code changes -- restart the app to pick up edits. Models not listed here keep the fully runtime-probed generic behaviour (per docs/wiim_api_notes.md: 'Capability detection must still probe at runtime... Never hard-code capabilities by model name alone'). Only documented exceptions to the generic probe are listed by default -- see docs/corrections.md and docs/wiim_api_notes.md Capability Nuances table. WiiM_Amp_Ultra/WiiM_Sound/WiiM_Sound_Lite previously needed a 'sources' override here because source enumeration wasn't possible; getAudioInputEnable now enumerates real sources at runtime for every model except WiiM_Mini, so only Mini (which supports neither that command nor RoomFit) still needs an entry. An optional top-level 'default_max_bands' key overrides the built-in 10-band fallback cap for every model without its own 'max_bands'.
